Author: Serpens66
Name: APIShared
Description: Shared typed native infrastructure and extensible lobby ModSettings preset API for Serps and third-party mods.

Changes: Add scoped packaged Lord presentation with complete lossless lordmeta.json, independent locale fallback, optional private media and synchronized speech selection.
Preserve claimed Coop AI names and portraits in the original restart object before serialization, without changing Lord gameplay types or Script Extender's global catalog.
Add opt-in visible-map render coordination with native dormant bypass and isolated preparation/cleanup callbacks.
Add shared pause-menu actions preserving Vanilla Quit, and opt-in popup sizing from the common resolution presets.
Add shared end-screen Pre/Accepted/Post events for buttons, game-over state and game-over text without changing existing API contracts.
Coordinate preview cancellation and delayed exit through guarded, caller-thread, at-most-once original continuations with isolated consumer failures.
Keep Map/Trail/Save source labels visible after loading personal presets and associate restored preset state with the correct mission working-copy session.

Add bounded settings-transition and persistence diagnostics with context/source/preset identities, dirty state, actual write results and target paths; include available exception type, HResult and exception details on failure.
Add Personal Settings as a reset source for editable Map and Trail working copies without leaving their context or overwriting personal settings and preset files.
Keep source selection, host/client ownership and backend restart handling consistent; prepare all target snapshots before a shared reset and preserve untouched backend state on failure.
Add owner-bound multiplayer map lookup providers and result observers for verified content outside Vanilla map catalogs.
Add lobby system-message classification through the existing renderer; preserve ordinary chat and existing localization.

Add owner-bound lobby launch-status providers with localized, deduplicated blocking and loading messages, local/lobby scopes and explicit rejected-command reporting; preserve Vanilla Ready/Start decisions.
Apply queued host settings on the Unity thread before multiplayer map initialization, preserving packet order and invalidating stale lobby or mission deliveries.

Support the current Fixes wheat-sale emitter as well as the historical stack-based variants; validate the complete bounded prefix, player identity and memory preimage before the single startup correction.
Log selected Custom Lord init.lua identities and warn when a package containing a script declares the local-only NetworkMode; preserve the Script Extender script-loading decision.
Correct lobby mismatch reporting and load-dialog integration while preserving consumer callbacks, cancellation and existing save/load behavior.
Include every changelog entry since the previous published stable APIShared release in GitHub release notes.
Give a confirmed multiplayer save load its own bounded 30-second start window and capture each participant snapshot once when checking host settings.
Validate the prepared plague-height backend stubs against the complete generated machine-code contract instead of fixed RedBird/Iced file hashes; reject incompatible output before activation.
Extend the hash-bound NativeKnowledge function annotations and integration reference without introducing a native invocation API.
Move APIShared-owned interface text to cached UTF-8 language catalogs, with complete German/English, English substitutes for other game languages and embedded English recovery.
Preserve consumer preset translations and English fallback contracts. Package independent localization resources with the Workshop publisher and generated warning bootstrap.
Name the lobby rejection dialog Different mods without asserting incompatibility; retain complete difference values in the client log.

Add opt-in TextBox StateValue metadata for configured-value search filters. Bind an authoritative numeric property independently of formatted display text and use InactiveValues to declare neutral values.
Preserve all existing checkbox, slider and unannotated TextBox behavior. Observe numeric changes through the existing managed catalog; unsupported bindings and nonnumeric values remain unknown.
Include the reviewed lobby rejection popup correction: show named differences and local/host versions, preserve the Extender join decision and always point to the complete client log.
Add owner-bound PopularityOverrides registrations and immutable PopularityOverrideValues for independent nullable Human/AI report-point contributions across ordinary popularity sources.

Add FearPopularityRegistration.SetTargetedLevelContributions while retaining all existing multiplier and uniform level-table APIs. Compose by source, role and level; copy and validate complete updates before atomic publication.

Capture the audited player/resource identity once per Extender calculation; select each contribution before its original arithmetic. Reports and previews use the same viewed-player policy, preserving foreign global values and independent legacy fear availability.

Add live Active/Inactive state filtering to registered local and global ModSettings searches, including safe checkbox and slider classification, explicit inactive values, inherited filter context and state-change notifications.
Keep preset snapshots, search catalogs and state filters consistent after setting restoration; preserve host authority, mission locks and existing text-only search behavior.

Add FearPopularityRegistration.SetLevelContributions for fixed whole popularity points per signed fear level. Positive and negative levels can be configured independently, including zero-valued contributions; the neutral fear level remains unchanged.

Compose per-level tables with existing multiplier registrations using the established order, owner GUID and registration ID. Unspecified levels retain earlier applicable policies or the original Script Extender calculation. Input tables are copied, setters replace the registration's complete configuration, and invalid or overflowing updates preserve its previous state.

Keep simulation and the popularity report on the same selected fear contribution. When an override replaces a foreign Script Extender coefficient, the report no longer evaluates that unused coefficient first, avoiding unrelated overflow.

Add an owner-bound plague-height capability for independent wall, gate, tower and keep policies with configurable height tolerance. Native hooks and a common standing-height helper avoid managed callbacks for damage candidates.

Compose active owners by surface and maximum tolerance; with no active policy, all four hooks retain the complete Vanilla path. Hooks remain installed for the process lifetime and unsupported native images disable only this capability.

Add general multi-mod tooltip contributions with literal strings, text/image segments and semantic placements for buildings, recruitment, siege construction and repair. Preserve existing Vanilla controls and collapse empty content completely.
Keep the existing building-text and repair binding contracts compatible; centralize rendering, hover context and mission/HUD retirement.

Add shared AI market reserve and pre-booking quantity policies, with composable native stock safety, ordered optional callbacks and process-lifetime hook ownership. The hook backend is verified at run time (displaced span, generated stub, jump form) instead of by pinned backend file hashes, so Script Extender updates keep the policies; another mod's hook at an audited continuation boundary is accepted.

Public provider APIs instead of friend internals: RouteSearchEvents.BeginSearch with a public RouteSearchContext, AssassinPathAPI.BeginRouteOutput, EnemyBridgeDiagnosticBridge.PublishTopologyOwner and GateRoutingNativeLayout (run-time values instead of compiled-in constants); BugfixesAndQoL no longer has InternalsVisibleTo access.

Fixes: ModSettings search ignores unresolvable markup extensions and reads {}-escaped text, Workshop startup retries a subscription list that changes during Steam initialization, recruitment variant buttons attach their hover handlers once, search case folding no longer depends on the current culture, and a Workshop upload whose Unity dispatcher is gone fails instead of staying active.
First public release since 0.9.2; summarizes the unreleased development versions 0.10.0 to 0.12.4.

Multiplayer: every player needs the same APIShared version. A peer with an older save-readiness protocol blocks loading a save with a message naming both versions; update APIShared and the mods for all players together.

Savegames: prepare and verify host settings before loading (including Solo Multiplayer and Coop provenance) with authenticated peer readiness; own the load checkbox; load saves whose settings record is damaged or newer with the current settings instead of aborting.

Versioned per-mod save records (VersionedSaveData) with multiplayer comparison of simulation records, plus UnitSettledEvents, attributed SoundSourceEvents with source selection, the cooperative native-site registry, rounded fear popularity and MissionRestart.Run.

ModSettings presets: stored under Documents/SHCDE/APIShared so long game paths no longer prevent saving; reflected settings apply independently, a rejected value falls back to its default, and mission exit retries a failing setter at most three times; snapshots keep their ownership, Customize drafts and omitted nullable values.

Lobby settings arrive through the Unity main-thread FIFO with sender authority rechecked at delivery; personal settings wait for late player assignments; the applied settings of every registered mod are logged once per mission start as compact JSON.

Mission settings authoring, preparation and session services, immutable mod-data access, Trail-container extraction and the separate APIShared.Content library; mission restarts keep origin, active presets and author rules.

Coop AI start import: owner-bound plans for custom castles and AICs, a start preview (ICoopAiStartPreviewCapability) for start-button checks, and CoopAiSlotPlan.ConfirmedCandidateCount so a partly confirmed castle list yields to a synchronized complete one.
New shared services: RecruitmentAvailability, TroopActionHud, load/save requester coordination and explicit managed ModSettings search catalogs (with Unicode and emoji repair).

Optional Fixes mod: the wheat-sale hook correction is derived from the actual game and Fixes code instead of file hashes, versions or fixed addresses; the Script Extender popularity display and interpolate-event reuse are corrected safely.
Workshop: complete repair as a clean reinstallation, early dependency bootstrap, and Script Extender cleanup accepted by signature and IL validation instead of binary hashes.
Logging: warnings and errors as throttled MOD_WARNING/MOD_FAILURE lines with feature and cause; Info is always written and kept to one-time markers; Debug output is opt-in.
Robustness: managed capability members are checked at startup with isolated initialization; skirmish restarts in the editor, from another thread or without a tracked mission keep Vanilla's restart.

Performance: faster startup (no thread suspension during the library-load run, cached fingerprints and pattern checks), fewer allocations in broker, audio, HUD and selection paths, optimized Release build, and cheaper assassin drawbridge route reconstruction.
Supports long installation paths and isolated working-tree builds; public API compatibility baselines and regression tests are maintained separately from in-game acceptance.
Fix Workshop updater handoff when ready.flag is still being written or briefly locked; never accept readiness from an updater that has already exited.
Fall back to steam -applaunch when the Proton restart through xdg-open is unavailable or fails, without undoing a completed installation.
Recover interrupted Workshop installations with explicit repair or rollback and preserved backups.
Protect updates against premature game restarts, report interrupted progress, and retain only two completed updates per package.
Avoid routine failure dialogs and unnecessary maintenance processes; bound maintenance and fix Bash recovery checks.
Add a public owner-bound broker for coloured supplementary building-tooltip lines without moving Vanilla cost anchors.
Add owner-bound situational sound Pre/Post events with composable volume factors, Vanilla effect replacement, suppression, panorama and isolated callback rollback.
Add preloaded custom OGG/PCM16 WAV clip handles from private mod resources, map archives and imported Extender clip IDs, with typed playback targets and map-lifetime invalidation.

Catalog 91 soldier and military-support sound sources with stable situation names, source/unit-type attribution and explicit Unknown, Inferred, NativeAudited or InGameConfirmed evidence. Unknown contexts remain usable for generic rules.
Approved audio contract change: named situations can be provisional; inspect SituationEvidence or SituationConfirmed. Custom playback targets expose SoundId=-1 rather than an effect ID.
Allow asset mods with nonnumeric version strings during Workshop discovery; require comparable versions only for bounded dependencies and prefer loaded plugin versions over asset metadata.
Distinguish first installation, updates and migration of existing Workshop files in the German and English startup confirmation, without treating the bootstrap as an installed payload.
Wait for the Workshop decision during Steam initialization before continuing startup, while validating and staging files in the background.
Add opt-in Workshop inventory cleanup and explicit savegame-settings exclusion for independent plugin entry points.
Add owner-bound Chore and copied Unity-thread message channels, shared transport preflight and third-party networking examples.
Add optional, binary-validated Script Extender dependency fixes and protect UU-ImGUI shutdown during Alt+F4 and normal menu exit.
Add shared cancellable GameAction and presentation events, recruitment material UI coordination, and native market price query events.
Focus the public API on shared services, expose route search events, separate mod-owned command runtimes, and align assembly version metadata.
Updated Script Extender 2.14.0 unit field contracts; preserved death-marker and full control-word semantics.
Move routine diagnostics to Debug; preserve warnings, errors and explicit file-operation results.
Added shared native-ordered gatehouse/drawbridge spatial coupling for main and test mods.
Isolate optional configuration registration failures and expose recoverable restart preparation status.
Added shared gatehouse and drawbridge automation capabilities and manual-control state handling.
Extended dynamic preset settings, grouped setting descriptions, and preset/savegame capacity limits.
Added startup-setting preparation and restart checks for presets and savegame loading.
Improved optional AI build diagnostics and enemy-gate/bridge path-policy integration.
Added shared interfaces for optional enemy-gate path policies and region-query observation.
Improved optional AI wood-building diagnostics and added scoped nearby-search observation.
Separated the controlled player from the selected spectator view for shared APIs and Script Extender callers.
Updated the shared package version for the ExtraFeatures repair settings icon fix.
Saved games now retain compatible mod settings and Trail creator rules.
Added an on-demand shared building repair capability with complete resource costs and tooltips.
Added a shared, demand-driven snapshot of the local troop selection.
Avoided constructing the game ViewModel during early mod-settings registration, restoring fast startup.
Added the public extensible lobby ModSettings preset API, loose JSON discovery, typed ExtendedData integration, copy actions, and atomic preset export.
Rebuilt and verified for compatibility with Script Extender 2.7.1.
Kept troop-selection refreshes isolated from process-wide HUD image overrides.
Kept mixed Lord and troop selections synchronized in the troop HUD regardless of selection order.
Accelerated native signature searches while preserving all validation, ambiguity, and hook contracts.
Fixed the barracks recruitment XAML contract and isolated independent unit-HUD presentation failures.
Kept Vanilla troop and army HUD presentation intact when required shared XAML elements are unavailable.
Added conflict-aware barracks recruitment image slots to the shared unit HUD pipeline.
Added the shared deterministic AIV build-step observer broker and centralized control-group mutation.
Deferred HUD refresh work until the vanilla MainViewModel and HUD_Main are fully initialized.
Renamed the shared API project, assembly, namespace, GUID, and public contract to APIShared.
Adjusted to Script Extender 2.3.0.
Updated the mod for Script Extender 2.2.0.
